services.name: Landing Page
services.summary: One page, one message, one clear action.
services.description: A landing page is a single screen of content dedicated to one offer, one announcement or one action. It keeps the visitor's attention in one place instead of spreading it across a whole site.

services.name: One-Page Website
services.summary: A single scrolling page with every section you need.
services.description: A one-page website keeps everything on a single scrolling page, organised into sections such as an introduction, services, pricing and contact. It suits businesses that want a complete overview in one place.

services.name: Multi-Page Website
services.summary: Separate pages with shared navigation, room to grow.
services.description: A multi-page website spreads content across separate pages linked by a shared navigation. It works when different parts of your business need room of their own, or when your content keeps growing.
